newsitem.title: GREECE: NAT'L INSURANCE SIGNS UP GREEK TROOPS.
newsitem.headline: NAT'L INSURANCE SIGNS UP GREEK TROOPS.

text.p: Greece's National Insurance signed with the Greek defence ministry a group life assurance contract for the 800-strong force stationed in Albania, the ministry said in a statement.

National Insurance quarantees full assurance on death or permanent damages caused to Greek troops during their stay in Albania where they participate in the Italian-led 'Alba' force assisting the distribution of humanitarian aid to trouble-ridden Albanians.
According to the terms of the contract, maximum liability claims may reach 5.0 million drachmas for officers and 3.0 million for lower ranking officers and call-up soldiers.
Greek troops sent to Albania currently number 120 officers and 680 troopers.
Another 70 to 80 army personnel will shortly be sent to Albania. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
